snippet.title: Official Sniper Elite: Resistance | Vercors Vendetta DLC Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Sniper Elite: Resistance is OUT NOW! The game is available on Game Pass, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Windows PC and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store. Sniper Elite: Resistance is also available on PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4.

Vercors Vendetta Mission and Weapons Pack

Despite destroying the primary Nazi stockpile of the deadly nerve agent Kleine Blume, one final cache survived! This stash has now been loaded into artillery shells ready for an imminent launch against multiple targets throughout France. With millions of civilian lives at stake, Harry Hawker launches a daring attempt to neutralise the remaining Wunderwaffe before they can be deployed.

To help you complete your mission, the M1941 Rifle and Armaguerra OG-44 will be added to your arsenal. Used by the U.S Marine Corps, the M1941 is a powerful rifle with a 10-round high-capacity rotary magazine, requiring fewer reloads. Whereas the Italian Armaguerra OG-44 is a submachine gun that has a recoil mechanism housed above the barrel, resulting in extremely low vertical recoil.

The Vercors Vendetta Mission and Weapons Pack contains: 

• The Vercors Vendetta Campaign Mission
• M1941 Rifle
• Armaguerra OG-44 Submachine Gun

Out Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2169200/Sniper_Elite_Resistance/
Out Now on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10008716
Out Now on Xbox:  https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/sniper-elite-resistance/9p962z5ps4m1
Out Now on Epic:  https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/sniper-elite-resistance

Directed by: Mario Cifuentes
Edited By: Impaired Visions
Narrated By: Scott Tunnix
Gameplay Capture By: Mario Cordaro
Scripted & Written By: Mike Alexander, Mario Cifuentes
Thumbnail By: Sean Hoffert

#Rebellion #SniperElite #SniperEliteResistance
